purpose: LLM-facing canonical building and exterior-variant manifest for future mystery story generation, art selection, and consistency checks.

style_contract.genre: painterly-realistic rural British mystery village for an elevated overhead map
style_contract.base_lighting: neutral daylight; runtime applies time-of-day and case mood tinting
art_rules: Treat interiors as architectural authority for exterior continuity.
Use canonical base exteriors for the living town.
Use case variants only for visible state changes such as damage, garden identity, or placement-specific shells.
Do not bake culprit identity, hidden evidence, blood, labels, or clue markers into base art.
Keep signage symbolic or unreadable unless a future UI layer supplies text.
Avoid pixel-art, RPG-sprite, chibi, cartoon, toy-like, and fantasy-medieval rendering.
Treat the 32px grid as placement geometry, never as an environment style target.
Never enlarge a map building module into a cinematic Places scene.
Use docs/scene_asset_bible.md and dedicated HD artwork for Places investigations.

technical_notes.camera: consistent elevated top-down/isometric map camera; not a cinematic Places camera
technical_notes.background: generated on light checkerboard/neutral asset canvas

canonical_buildings.interior_description: Warm village cafe with teal painted door and wall panelling, large arched street window with curtains, long service counter, brass till, display case, tables, kitchen doorway, shelves, and blue-check cloth details.
canonical_buildings.exterior_description: Cream plaster and dark stone cafe with teal arched glass door, large arched curtained front window, blue-and-white checked awning cue, flower boxes, outdoor tables, and side stair/upstairs hint for Clara's flat.
continuity_cues: side stair implies Clara's flat above

case_time_tints.case_005: damp morning tint with rear-alley smoke/fog handled separately

canonical_buildings.interior_description: Narrow bookshop with aisles of tall shelves, display tables, service counter, reading/display areas, and private back-room/stockroom connection.
canonical_buildings.exterior_description: Tall, narrow shopfront with slate-blue roof, book-filled display bay, symbolic hanging book sign, flower boxes, and discreet rear service side.
continuity_cues: rear service side for back room

case_time_tints.case_006: evening/night tint if used near estate storyline

case_time_tints.case_004: night tint with nearby square lamp

canonical_buildings.exterior_description: Modest two-storey residential flats with stone ground floor, cream rendered upper floor, paired windows, shared central stair/entry, simple fence and hedges.

canonical_buildings.exterior_description: Humble single-storey cottage with cream plaster, pale stone, terracotta roof, chimney, simple front door, compact fenced garden, and bedroom-window cue.

canonical_buildings.interior_description: Ordinary small house with sitting room, kitchen, bedroom, and compact domestic layout.
canonical_buildings.exterior_description: Reusable modest village house with cream plaster, pale stone, timber trim, pitched roof, chimney, small garden path, hedges, and simple flowerbeds.

case_and_placement_variants.description: Small cottage variant with a large attractive foxglove garden: tall purple and pink bell-flower spikes behind a fence, ordinary cottage-garden presentation, no ominous or explicit poison symbolism.

runtime_hints.case_overlay_policy: harvested or searched plant states should be separate overlays, not baked into this variant

case_and_placement_variants.display_name: Reed & Bell Bookshop, Broken Back Window
case_and_placement_variants.description: Canonical bookshop exterior with subtle cracked/broken rear or side back-room window and tiny glass shards near the service side, representing staged forced entry.

use_canonical_for_new_stories: Use canonical_buildings as persistent living-town places.
Only choose variants when the story explicitly needs that placement identity or visible state.
When generating new mysteries, reuse story_affordances and continuity_cues before inventing new building features.
consistency_warnings: Do not describe Hobbs Cafe with brown-only trim or square-only windows; teal arched door/window cues are canonical.
Do not use Ruth's foxglove variant for generic cottages unless the story needs Ruth's garden.
Do not make Ben's flat a plain standalone flat if the story depends on the newsagent ground floor.
Do not make case damage appear in base canon: broken bookshop glass and rear-alley fire damage are variants.
Do not bake specific evidence into art descriptions; evidence state belongs to runtime clue/object logic.
